nodes.description: Address state variable storing the contract owner, set once in the constructor and read by the restricted modifier.
Unsigned integer state variable tracking the last completed migration; written by setCompleted and forwarded by upgrade.
Access-control modifier that only allows execution when msg.sender equals owner.
Constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment time.
External function guarded by the restricted modifier that writes the completed value into last_completed_migration.
External, unguarded function that casts an attacker-supplied address to Migrations and invokes setCompleted on it.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, ownership comparison and unrestricted entry into upgrade.
External call upgraded.setCompleted(last_completed_migration) on an arbitrary address supplied by the caller, executed without any access control.
Parameter of setCompleted carrying the value to be stored in last_completed_migration.
Parameter of upgrade supplying the target contract address for the external setCompleted call.

edges.reason: The completed parameter is consumed by setCompleted.
The completed parameter is written directly into the last_completed_migration state variable.
Owner authority is derived from the untrusted caller address msg.sender in the constructor.
The constructor writes owner, establishing the privileged identity.
The restricted modifier compares the caller-controlled msg.sender against owner to grant privileged execution.
Owner is the reference value in the msg.sender == owner privilege check inside the restricted modifier.
The restricted modifier gates entry into setCompleted, enforcing owner-only writes.
Any caller (msg.sender) can invoke upgrade because it lacks the restricted modifier.
upgrade performs an external call into an arbitrary contract, allowing reentrant or hijacked execution.
The caller-supplied new_address controls the target of the external call, making the call address attacker-chosen.
The new_address parameter is used by upgrade to construct the Migrations instance.
The last_completed_migration state value is forwarded as the argument of the external call.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter has no independent semantics and is fully represented by the setCompleted function that consumes and stores it.
The new_address parameter only exists to supply the target of the external call initiated by upgrade, so it folds into that core function.
